name: Bare Bones x Mods
note: Official Modrinth project identifies a modded Bare Bones resource pack; author lists many supported mods and instructs placing it above its base and overlays. Pack order is author guidance, not a native compatibility result. ARR; no redistribution implied.

name: Farmer GUI
note: Official Modrinth page links the matching CurseForge farmergui project. Warm farmer-themed interface pack. Support lists are split by Minecraft version: do not apply the newer-version list to 1.20.1. ARR; no native verification.

name: Motschen's Better Leaves
note: Official Modrinth page links TeamMidnightDust/BetterLeavesLite. Version 9 uses pre-created leaf textures; customized texture packs may need recompilation. Version 8.1 and earlier dynamically adapt existing textures at a stated performance cost. These are author explanations, not measured FPS here; keep the two behaviors version-scoped.

name: Ars Loafers
note: Official CurseForge project 1254524 by loafobucket is an Ars Nouveau resource pack with addon support. Current description targets 1.21.1, while older files list 1.20.1. Project-wide support is not proof the latest archive works in every lane. Custom license; no native verification.

name: Bibliophilia | Enchanted Books
note: Official project requires CIT Resewn or Forge CIT for 1.18–1.21.1; 1.21.2–1.21.4 is unsupported and 1.21.5 works vanilla. Author reports incompatibility with Dynamic Trims. Do not mark the source native/drop-in claim as dependency-free.

name: Excalibur | Create Support
note: Official Create-to-Excalibur texture/model support pack by BoFill_Pablito. Author places it above Excalibur and publishes distinct Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1 archives; exact Create generation matters.

name: Retextures o’ Plenty
note: Official Biomes O Plenty resource pack by IcyCaeli. Author describes changes to over 300 textures and variants, currently for the base mod; addon support is planned rather than implemented.

name: Bare Bones x Farmer’s Delight
note: Official Bare Bones compatibility resource pack for Farmer’s Delight and several Delight addons. Author-listed completion differs by addon; do not promote the whole family to fully supported. ARR.

name: Excalibur | L_Ender’s Cataclysm Support
note: Official project lists Cataclysm entities, items, blocks and spawn eggs, plus random entity variants and 2D inventory icons for weapons. This is visual integration with Excalibur, not new gameplay or native compatibility qualification.

name: Fresh MythicBotany & Botania
note: Official project is a MythicBotany/Botania texture treatment; author explicitly requires Botania and MythicBotany. Retain exact-file version checks and distinguish vanilla-style visual redesign from new magic functionality.

name: L_Ender’s Cataclysm Reimagined
note: Official description limits this pack to GUI, HUD and item icons. It explicitly does not change world models, blocks or gameplay. Separate Forge and NeoForge file lanes are listed; do not mistake this for a complete world-model overhaul.

name: Excalibur | Aether Support
note: Official Aether support pack covers the original Aether visual ecosystem and belongs above Excalibur. Aether addon coverage is planned with no ETA, not completed support. Exact file versions still need qualification.

name: Excalibur | Mowzie's Mobs Support
note: Official Mowzie's Mobs visual support pack by Ruseki lists mobs, bosses, items, particles, boss bars and GUI. Pair with Excalibur and verify the exact mod/file versions. Author permits modpack inclusion but prohibits reuploading or redistributing the pack itself.

name: Excalibur | Iron’s Spells ’N Spellbooks Support
note: Official Iron's Spells Excalibur support pack is explicitly work in progress with many textures missing. Do not mark its catalogue presence as complete visual coverage or functional magic compatibility.

name: Ars Nouveau Refresh
note: Official Ars Nouveau Refresh page documents glyph, essence, charm/familiar and tablet icon redesigns. Mob/weapon/armor styling and addon item improvements appear on its roadmap; do not promote those plans to completed coverage.

name: Chaotix Apotheotic Tweaks
note: Official Apotheosis texture pack targets gems, charms, tomes, rarity materials, arrows and relevant workstations/GUI. It needs Apotheosis to have an effect; its Fabric Zenith version is a separate linked project, not the same compatibility lane.

name: Excalibur | Apotheosis Support
note: Apotheosis block, item and GUI visual support for Excalibur. Author instructs placing this above the base Excalibur pack. Separate 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 v2.0 files are listed; choose the exact target release. This is a visual pack, not an Apotheosis gameplay compatibility patch.

name: Excalibur | Farmer’s Delight Support
note: Author describes 411 item/block textures and considers the pack complete for its stated scope; this is not our runtime qualification of all Farmer’s Delight addons. Place above base Excalibur. Select a release matching the actual Minecraft/mod versions instead of assuming the newest file works on 1.20.1.

name: Pinnacle (for Apotheosis)
note: Apotheosis-only visual refresh; requires Apotheosis to have an effect. Page lists a 1.20.1 3.0.0.5 backport and a separate 1.21.1 3.0.0 release, while the author states ongoing focus is 1.21.1+. Do not treat availability of the backport as a promise of future maintenance. Shares Apotheosis texture targets with other visual packs, so choose precedence and inspect overlaps.

name: Connected Paths
note: Connected-texture resource pack; author requires OptiFine or Continuity. Support is version-scoped: several ecosystems are listed, while Create, Alex’s Caves and others remain planned. A pack-format edit alone does not implement the required connected-texture renderer. The similarly named Connected Paths Mod is a separate dynamic-generation project, not this resource pack.

name: Stay True
note: Vanilla-style visual variation pack. Author lists OptiFine for connected textures, overlays and pink birch leaves, and advises fancy leaves plus appropriate connected-texture/alternate-block settings. The page has pack-priority advice for Fabric users; renderer alternatives and a specific Forge/Vulkan stack need separate validation. Distinct from Stay True Compats Reforged.

name: Ars Naturae
note: Nature-themed Ars Nouveau visual pack using brown woods, mossy stone and blue Source styling. Author mentions addons without a complete support inventory. The inspected project lists a 1.20.1 file; do not infer 1.21.1 support or coverage of every Ars addon. Compare overlapping texture targets with other Ars visual packs.
